recordSet.description: Station metadata from the Estonian Environment Agency (Keskkonnaagentuur) across its keskkonnaandmed.envir.ee PostgREST registry (f_seirejaamad, seiretyyp=HJ: station name `nimi` and water body name `veekogu_nimi`) and estmodel.envir.ee station list (catchment `area` in km2). Elevation is withheld (`merepinnast` is null for all 60 stations in f_seirejaamad and absent in EstModel). Published under CC BY 4.0 with mandatory attribution under Keskkonnaseire seadus § 13(4).
